skills.name: Puffy Blaze
skills.description: Creates a ring of flames, dealing AoE damage and healing allies within range.

skills.name: Fluff Flame
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire extra flames forward, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Flutterflame
skills.description: Unleashes flaming butterflies, continuously dealing large AoE damage and inflicting Flutterflame: Fragile.

skills.name: Wing Embrace
skills.description: Spreads wings to grant allies within range Wing Embrace: All Stats UP.

skills.name: Huff and Puff
skills.description: After taking damage from close-range enemies, counterattacks to deal AoE damage. When not counterattacking, meditates to recover HP.

skills.name: Ramen Stand
skills.description: Prepares a ramen stand. Attacks have a chance to fire extra ramen that heals allies.

skills.name: Yakitori Grill
skills.description: Prepares a yakitori grill. Periodically recovers HP while firing grilled skewers to deal small AoE damage. After taking damage, skewer cooldowns are reduced.

skills.name: Warship Roll
skills.description: Steers a warship roll that deals damage in its path. After, the warship explodes to deal AoE damage and inflict Burn. The explosion center deals follow-up damage and inflicts stun.

skills.name: Ember Pop
skills.description: Shoots a ball of fire, dealing limited AoE damages and burning enemies.

skills.name: Rapid Fire
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire 3 extra fire orbs.

skills.name: Fire Trigger
skills.description: When inflicting Burn, there is a chance to fire a follow-up fire orb at the target location.

skills.name: Blazing Path
skills.description: Paves a blazing path forward, dealing wide-range AoE damage with a chance to inflict Burn.

skills.name: Bud Venom
skills.description: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots a venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict Poison.

skills.name: Bitter Bane
skills.description: Has a chance to apply 1 stack of Bane when inflicting Poison. Also has a chance to deal small AoE damage when applying Bane. Bane is a stackable lingering effect that deals damage continuously over time.

skills.name: Shade Spray
skills.description: Periodically launches 5 shadows to deal single-target damage and apply 1 stack of Bane. Shadows will pierce enemies with Bane.

skills.name: Shadow Bloom
skills.description: Summons many shadows to deal large AoE damage, inflicting 1 stack of Bane and doubling the enemy's current stacks. Prioritizes attacking bosses.

skills.name: Bright Hug
skills.description: Shines down sunlight, healing allies and granting them Sunshine - ATK Boost.

skills.name: Warm Aura
skills.description: Activates an AoE buff that continuously grants a Shield to allies in range.

skills.name: Tint Shades
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to shine down strange sunlight, damaging enemies within range and inflicting Stun.

skills.name: Full Sun
skills.description: Shines down sunlight across the entire battlefield, inflicting Stun while granting allies Sunshine: ATK Boost.

skills.name: Needle Rain
skills.description: Launches spines to inflict Sting. DMG increases with the number of Sting stacks.

skills.name: Prickly Pace
skills.description: Periodically gains ATK Speed.

skills.name: Spiny Fans
skills.description: Launches 3 bursts of fan-shaped spines.

skills.name: Prickly Pal
skills.description: Periodically summons a cactus ally that fires piercing spines in 8 directions. The spines explode after a delay, dealing small AoE damage.

skills.name: Citrus Shot
skills.description: Shoots a zesty bullet.

skills.name: Peeler
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire an extra peeled orange to heal allies.

skills.name: Jumbo Orange
skills.description: Launches 1 jumbo orange that heals allies and grants them Orange: ATK Boost and Orange: DMG Boost.

skills.name: Quick Orange
skills.description: Continuously fires zesty bullets.

skills.name: Electro Cage
skills.description: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals small AoE damage after impact.

skills.name: Cavy Cage
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to create an additional smaller Electricage that continuously deals small AoE damage and inflicts Bind or Slow on some affected enemies.

skills.name: Full Tilt!
skills.description: Creates 2 bounce devices. Orbs will ricochet between devices and deal damage to enemies in their path.

skills.name: Electric Circuit
skills.description: Periodically Summons Cavyzap allies that form an electric connection to deal damage to enemies in their path.

skills.name: Bunny Dance
skills.description: Dances continuously, dealing AoE damage while healing nearby allies and granting them Support - ATK Boost and DEF Boost

skills.name: Rhythmic Pierce
skills.description: Periodically fires piercing sound waves that damage enemies and heal allies.

skills.name: Just Dance
skills.description: Periodically grants invincibility to nearby allies.

skills.name: Zap Chord
skills.description: Periodically launches 3 zap waves, dealing large AoE damage with a chance to inflict Slow, Bind, or Stun.

skills.name: Pinecone Mine
skills.description: Plants a Pinecone Mine that deals limited AoE damage when triggered.

skills.name: Pinecone Bomb
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire an extra Pinecone Bomb, dealing limited-range AoE damage with a chance to inflict Stun.

skills.name: Fluff Ranger
skills.description: Periodically summons Cindermunk to plant mines on the battlefield, which deal limited AoE damage when triggered.

skills.name: Hold Steady
skills.description: Plants a minefield that deal wide-range AoE damage after a short delay.

skills.name: Seedshot
skills.description: Shoots one seed.

skills.name: Seed Trigger
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to shoot extra damaging seeds or healing seeds.

skills.name: Chain Heal
skills.description: When Weakened allies are nearby, provides continuous healing to that ally.

skills.name: Seedscatter
skills.description: Rapidly shoots lots of damaging or healing seeds at different targets.

skills.name: Claw Swing
skills.description: Swings its claw, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Claw-Covery
skills.description: Periodically recovers HP. Surplus healing is converted into a shield.

skills.name: Crab Knock
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to deal large AoE damage and inflict Knockback.

skills.name: Crab Claw
skills.description: Fires clawed attacks that continuously deal AoE damage to the upper right toward the edge of the map.

skills.name: Drowsy Shot
skills.description: Launches water bombs, dealing damage and slowing enemies. The slow can be upgraded to a sleep effect.

skills.name: Aqua Flutter
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to launch 1 piercing butterfly from the target's location.

skills.name: Resonant Flutter
skills.description: Periodically grants multiple allies the following effect: Attacks have a chance to launch an extra butterfly.

skills.name: Torrential Flutter
skills.description: Summons several butterfly allies. Releases a piercing mist that deals damage, with a chance to inflict Sleep.

skills.name: Needle Leech
skills.description: Fires 3 thorns while dozing off, gradually restoring health.

skills.name: Extra Spikes
skills.description: When taking damage, there is a chance to launch extra spikes.

skills.name: Spike Shot
skills.description: Launches densely-packed spikes.

skills.name: Spike Vest
skills.description: When many enemies are nearbym gains DMG Reduction and continuously fires spikes.

skills.name: Whirl Claw
skills.description: Swipes at enemies in front. After several attacks, inflicts Knockback on at most 2 enemies and forces them into adjacent rows. Inflicts Shredded on enemies that cannot be Knocked Back.

skills.name: Shredding Stab
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to launch an extra stab forward, dealing AoE damage and inflicting DEF Down. Gains DEF Boost based on the number of enemies hit.

skills.name: Crowd Crusher
skills.description: Periodically gains a Sunder Shield. Value of the shield is based on the number of enemies nearby. The more enemies, the higher the shield value.

skills.name: Where To?
skills.description: Able to move above the deployment area. Periodically gains Prepared. After moving, expends Prepared to deal large AoE damage. When in Danger, retreats and recovers HP while losing this skill's effect for some time.

skills.name: Cloud Mist
skills.description: Releases a mist that continuously deals AoE damage and slows enemies.

skills.name: Sleep Mist
skills.description: Emits a sleep-inducing mist, dealing small AoE damage with a chance to inflict Sleep.

skills.name: Boom Mist
skills.description: When dealing damage, has a chance to generate an explosive mist around the target that deals small AoE damage.

skills.name: Sea Fog
skills.description: Summons sea fog, inflicting Super Fragile on all enemies.

skills.name: Fishy Form
skills.description: Launches a water orb that deals damage. Occasionally launches a large water orb that deals AoE damage and summons a small octopus, which deals AoE damage when knocked down.

skills.name: Ink Splatter
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to launch an extra ink bomb, dealing AoE damage with a chance to inflict Blind.

skills.name: Force Field
skills.description: Periodically creates an expanding force field, granting DMG Reduction to allies in range.

skills.name: Octo-Nuke
skills.description: Drops an octopus nuke that deals large AoE damage. Prioritizes attacking the weakest boss and deals extra damage to the center of the battlefield.

skills.name: Meow Pop
skills.description: Throws jewels that deal damage. Damage occasionally bounces with increasing throws.

skills.name: Cat Contempt
skills.description: Has a chance to inflict Weak when dealing damage. Cooldown applies separately to each enemy.

skills.name: Sweeping Jewel
skills.description: Summons a sweeping jewel for synchronized attacks, dealing damage to enemies in its path.

skills.name: More Jewels
skills.description: Launches a piercing jewel that deals increasing damage the farther it flies. Continuously deals AoE damage upon reaching its target.

skills.name: Static Fluff
skills.description: Summons white clouds to unleash lightning, dealing continuous AoE DMG. Fire arcs to move clouds.

skills.name: Flash Bolt
skills.description: Fires a lightning lance.

skills.name: Cloud Crash
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to launch a cloud that moves in a fixed direction. The cloud continuously emits lightning, dealing small AoE damage and disappearing when it hits the edge of the battlefield.

skills.name: Grim Skies
skills.description: Summons 2 large dark clouds that continuously move forward. Clouds emit multiple lightning strikes and deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Frost Block
skills.description: Fires an ice block that slows enemies.

skills.name: Ice Burst
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire an extra Ice Block, dealing AoE damage with a chance to inflict Freeze.

skills.name: Ice Scatter
skills.description: Periodically fires scattered icicles that inflict Slow on enemies.

skills.name: Frost Path
skills.description: Paves an ice path forwards, dealing wide-range AoE damage with a chance to inflict Freeze.

skills.name: Puffruit Pop
skills.description: Launches a prickly pink fruit that occasionally explodes, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Bomb Chain
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire an extra exploding fruit that deals AoE damage.

skills.name: Quick Slice
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire extra regular fruits, which continuously deals large AoE damage on hit.

skills.name: Fruit Rain
skills.description: Rains down a torrent of fruits toward the front, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Stinky Fumes
skills.description: Emits noxious gas that continuously deals AoE damage. The gas sometimes ignites, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Ember Pop
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to launch a fire orb.

skills.name: Fervent Fumes
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to emit noxious fumes rearward, granting Fumes: ATK & DEF Boost to allies in the back.

skills.name: Firework Frenzy
skills.description: Continuously fires flames forward, with each flame dealing small AoE damage.

skills.name: Buzzed Ring
skills.description: Emits a ring of spores that expands, continuously dealing damage to enemies in range. Deals small amount of damage to allies while granting them ATK and SPD Boost.

skills.name: Weakening Spore
skills.description: Launches 1 weakening spore, with a chance to inflict Fragile.

skills.name: Exploding Spores
skills.description: When an enemy dies nearby, triggers an explosion that deals small AoE damage. If the enemy was killed by this Tatari, the explosion deals large AoE damage.

skills.name: Longevity Spores
skills.description: Spreads longevity spores that continuously deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Spike Spiral
skills.description: Launches a piercing spinning shell.

skills.name: Quake
skills.description: Periodically triggers an earthquake, dealing wide-range AoE damage.

skills.name: Shell Bounce
skills.description: Launches a shell that bounces between allies, granting each a Shell Shield and dealing damage to enemies.

skills.name: Shell Burst
skills.description: Launches piercing spinning shells in 8 directions.

families.name: Glowfly

skills.name: Glowing Guardian
skills.description: Grants one front row ally a Static Shield. The shield deals AoE damage when it disappears.

skills.name: Luminous Bolt
skills.description: Periodically launches 1 ricocheting orb(s) that deals slight damage to enemies and inflicts paralysis. Grants allies 1 stack of Glow: Periodically recovers HP; 2 stacks: Attacks inflict paralysis; 3 stacks: Consumes all Glow stacks to recover HP and inflict knockback on enemies in front.

skills.name: Fulgur Fusion
skills.description: Fires a lightning bolt forward that deals slight damage to enemies and inflicts paralysis. Grants allies 1 stack of stackable Glow.

skills.name: Radiant Glow
skills.description: Grants allies in front 1 stack of stackable Glow.

families.notes: The effects of "Glow" are not mentioned anywhere, however the stats are: Level 1: Treats 2.5% of maximum health every 4 seconds Level 2: Deals damage with a "paralysis" effect Level 3: Uses up all "fluorescence", pushes back an enemy in front by 1 space, and restores 7.5% of maximum health to itself.

skills.name: Bugrush
skills.description: Grants invincibility and dashes forward, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Vital Fumes
skills.description: Attacks grant allies from behind Exhaust: DMG Boost and Exhaust: ATK Boost.

skills.name: Airborne Ops
skills.description: Periodically deals extra small AoE damage in the surrounding area while attacking.

skills.name: Chain Charge
skills.description: Periodically summons a Goonbug ally for an offensive charge.

skills.name: Mud Ball
skills.description: Continuously fires mud balls at close range. Stops attacking when enemies are nearby, but grants damage reduction.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to trigger extra smoke, dealing AoE damage and inflicting Weak on enemies.

skills.name: Escape Route
skills.description: When enemies are nearby, continuously deals large AoE damage in the surrounding area.

skills.name: Gopher Group
skills.description: Summons a group of Gopher allies to attack continuously.

skills.name: Dawn Call
skills.description: Creates an AoE terrain in front. Enemies in the terrain take damage and are inflicted with stackable Slowdown.

skills.name: Timed Therapy
skills.description: Periodically heals nearby allies, with heal frequency occasionally increased.

skills.name: Winged Rewind
skills.description: Periodically records the positions of enemies in range. After a period of time, moves enemies to their recorded positions.

skills.name: Circle of Life
skills.description: Summons owl allies whose tiers do not exceed this Tatari's own. Summoned allies move across the battlefield and continuosly deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Dung Sling
skills.description: Launches dung balls that briefly linger on hit, dealing AoE DMG over time.

skills.name: Boom Ball
skills.description: When dealing damage, there is a chance to trigger an explosion that deals AoE damage.

skills.name: Bounce Ball
skills.description: Launches 3 piercing balls that bounce upon hitting the left or right edge of the battlefield.

skills.name: Spin Ball
skills.description: Fires a spinning ball that creates an expanding vortex on hit, pulling enemies in and dealing AoE damage over time.

skills.name: Jab Flurry
skills.description: Throws punches, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Combo!
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to trigger an extra shadow punch that deals AoE damage.

skills.name: Counterpunch!
skills.description: Has a chance to counter when attacked, entering an evade state and gaining brief invincibility.

skills.name: Super Launch!
skills.description: Punches randomly within the surrounding area and ends with a super punch finisher that deals large AoE damage.

skills.name: Buzz Punch
skills.description: Unleashes electrified punches that deal AoE damage diminishing with distance, with attack speed increasing slowly over time.

skills.name: Got Gold?
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to drop gold coins that turn into energizer when they disappear.

skills.name: Golden Charity
skills.description: Periodically grants 2 random allies ATK Boost.

skills.name: Rain of Riches
skills.description: Summons gold coins in a large area to the front, inflicting damage and Stun. Has a chance to obtain energizers.

skills.name: Toungue Out
skills.description: Shoots multiple small globs of spit at enemies alone on a tile, or a large glob at multiple enemies on a tile. Spit deals limited-range AoE damage and inflicts Slow.

skills.name: Bushy Boost
skills.description: Periodically grants DMG Boost to nearby allies.

skills.name: Sticky Spit
skills.description: Shoots sticky spit to deal AoE damage and leaves behind a Strong Slow Zone.

skills.name: Precision Guidance
skills.description: Spits continuously in the direction of recent movement. Priotritizes locking onto bosses.

skills.name: Sapping Orb
skills.description: Launches a water orb, dealing AoE DMG. Drains HP from nearby healthy allies to boost DMG and heal nearby allies with low HP.

skills.name: Splash Shot
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire 2 extra water orbs.

skills.name: Bubble Pop
skills.description: Launches a large bubble, dealing AoE damage with a chance to inflict Stun.

skills.name: Jelly Pal
skills.description: Periodically summons a jelly pal that deals AoE damage.

skills.name: Double Slash
skills.description: Performs 2 rapid strikes, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Petal Blades
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to throw an extra 2 petal blades.

skills.name: Healblades
skills.description: Has a chance to throw petal blades when healed. Periodically recovers HP.

skills.name: Wild Slashes
skills.description: Wildly swings dual scythes, continuously dealing large AoE damage while recovering HP. Becomes briefly Stunned after.

skills.name: Dagon's Wave
skills.description: Summons waves that inflict Pull and a whirlpool that deals small AoE damage.

skills.name: Seeping Gaze
skills.description: Periodically summons a whirlpool nearby, dealing small AoE damage and inflicting Slow.

skills.name: Primordial Boon
skills.description: Periodically gains a shield. WHen the shield disappears, recovers HP based on shield value consumed.

skills.name: Abyssal Maw
skills.description: Summons whirlpools in multiple rows that inflict slow. When a whirlpool explodes, it deals damage to enemies while inflicting stun and Tidesurge: Fragile

skills.name: Momo's Kiss
skills.description: Sends a kiss (not bite) to deal AoE damage and deals increased damage to Frail enemies. After killing an enemy, pauses attacks to recover HP.

skills.name: Pounding Hearts
skills.description: Periodically launches hearts that deal 1 damage to the target and inflict stun, while also dealing damage to nearby enemies

skills.name: Pink Protection
skills.description: Periodically grants nearby allies a Strike Shield that prevents several counts of damage. The prevented damage count increases as this Tatari evolves.

skills.name: Lovely Barrier
skills.description: Generates a lovely barrier that intercepts enemy projectiles. Intercept count increases as this Tatari evolves.

skills.name: Dirt Dab
skills.description: Shoots a ball of mud.

skills.name: Dried Mud
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to shoot an extra large mud ball that pierces enemies.

skills.name: Mud Madness
skills.description: When enemies are nearby, attacks have a chance to shoot an extra mud ball.

skills.name: Mud Fest
skills.description: Continuously shoots mud balls, sweeping across a fan-shaped area to the front.

skills.name: Slow Shoots
skills.description: Plants bamboo shoots that continuously deal damage and slow enemies. Bamboo shoots grow 1 time(s), with damage increasing once grown.

skills.name: Panda Power
skills.description: When dealing damage, there is a chance to summon a Pandaroo ally around the target, dealing small AoE damage.

skills.name: Mead Toss
skills.description: Throws mead to 1 ally, granting them Mead: ATK Boost and ATK Speed Boost.

skills.name: Bambattle
skills.description: Generates bamboo groves at the locations of all allies. Allies in groves gain DMG Boost and DMG Reduction.

skills.name: Sizzle Bubble
skills.description: Spits flames, dealing AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Toadie Teleport
skills.description: When moving, instantly reaches the target location and grants nearby allies DMG Boost and ATK Boost.

skills.name: Croaker Chant
skills.description: Shares a mesmerizing song and continuosuly inflicts stun over a large area to the front.

skills.name: Oil Onsen
skills.description: Sprays scalding oil over a large area to theh front, inflicting slow. After, the oil ignites to continuosly deal damage and inflict burn. A final explosion deals follow-up damage.

skills.name: Clone Caper
skills.description: Wiggles its hips, dealing limited AoE damage. Can summon a clone to attack.

skills.name: Hit Me!
skills.description: Periodically summon an attackable clone that deals AoE damage when it disappears.

skills.name: Barricade
skills.description: When this Tatari or their summons take damage, there is a chance to gain Barricade: DMG Reduction.

skills.name: Staff Cyclone
skills.description: Spins a golden staff to deal continuous AoE damage. The staff will bounce if it hits the edge of the battlefield.

skills.name: Pyro Pillar
skills.description: Summons a fire pillar, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Fire Serpent
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to summon extra fire pillars that extend outward randomly.

skills.name: Flame Halo
skills.description: Periodically creates rings of fire orbs, dealing DoT damage in an area to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Hellflame
skills.description: Continuously summons powerful flame pillars in the surrounding area.

skills.name: Azure Flare
skills.description: Fires a searing blue beam, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Azure Shield
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to grant an extra Azure Shield.

skills.name: Heat Sweep
skills.description: Fires a sweeping heat beam, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Fault Line
skills.description: Attacks trigger an earthquake, dealing large AoE damage and inflicting Stun.

skills.name: Dewdrop
skills.description: Generates a Liquid Shield. While Liquid Shield is active, shoots green bubbles to deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Liquid Shield
skills.description: Whenever shield value changes, has a chance to shoot green bubbles horizontally and deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Spider Web
skills.description: Shoots a spider web, dealing large AoE damage with a chance to inflict Spider Web: Bind.

skills.name: Spider Lair
skills.description: Continuously summons small spiders that charge forward. The spiders can be attacked and explode upon death to deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Bubble Bounce
skills.description: Launches a bouncing ball that ricochets.

skills.name: Hit Practice
skills.description: Launches 2 piercing balls that, after flying a certain distance, will return and be launched again.

skills.name: Pressure Orb
skills.description: Launches a piercing high-pressure water orb that sometimes explodes to deal large AoE damage.

skills.name: Wave Blast
skills.description: Periodically summons massive waves, dealing large AoE damage with a chance to inflict Knockback.

skills.name: Crystal Cluster
skills.description: Launches crystal shards. Summons a crystal cluster at the start of the battle.

skills.name: Gem Cluster
skills.description: Periodically summons attackable gem clusters that continuously deal damage to enemies.

skills.name: Gem Burst
skills.description: Uses gem clusters to deal large AoE damage to surrounding enemies. If none exist, summons one before attacking.

skills.name: Gem Resonance
skills.description: Launches gem pieces that deal large AoE damage on hit and inflict Crystallized. Any gem clusters within range will resonate, repeating the effect.

skills.name: Bubble Wave
skills.description: Fires a wave of bubbles, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Bubble Line
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire and extra Bubble Wave, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Bubble Shield
skills.description: Periodically heals itself. Surplus healing is converted into a Shield.

skills.name: Super Bubble
skills.description: Launches super bubbles, dealing wide-range AoE damage and inflicting Slow.

skills.name: Quick Jabs
skills.description: Quickly throws 3 punches.

skills.name: Scattered Jabs
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to fire 3 waves of scattered punches.

skills.name: Blasting Jabs
skills.description: Attacks have a chance of dealing small AoE damage when connecting with enemies.

skills.name: Piercing Jabs
skills.description: Fires numerous waves of fan-shaped punches.

skills.name: Bubbles
skills.description: Launches bubbles, dealing AoE damage. Becomes invisible after taking certain amount of damage. While Invisible, prioritizes attacking enemies behind itself.

skills.name: Vortex Sap
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to summon an extra waterspout that continuously deals small AoE damage and inflicts Slow.

skills.name: Great Vortex
skills.description: Periodically summons a large waterspout that continuously deals large AoE damage.

skills.name: Technique: Veil
skills.description: Summons several waterspouts. Invisible Skinkoon allies will emerge to attack enemies with whirlpools.

skills.name: Fish Ahoy
skills.description: Throws 3 fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, eats 1 fish to recover HP and dispell all other debuffs.

skills.name: Always Cola
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to create 1 cola. The cola is either thrown to deal small AoE damage, or drunk to recover HP and obtain Cola: DMG Boost.

skills.name: Make it Swarm
skills.description: Throws 1 small fish that attracts bigger fish and marlins to deal damage to enemies in their path.

skills.name: Together is Better
skills.description: Places 7 cola baits that attract fish to deal small AoE damage. After, Large Marlin shares cola with all allies on the field, granting Cola: ATK & DEF Boost.

skills.name: Fruitfall
skills.description: Drops a torrent of pears that deal limited AoE damage.

skills.name: Pear Shield
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to grant an extra Pear Shield.

skills.name: Extra Pears
skills.description: Attacks have a chance to drop extra pears.

skills.name: Pear Rain
skills.description: Continuously drops 12 pear(s) in the surrounding area.

skills.name: Spicy Soup
skills.description: Spends HP to hurl peppers, dealing AoE damage based on the HP consumed, while granting allies a Culinary Shield. Heals a nearby allies when knocked down.

skills.name: Second Helping
skills.description: Has a chance to launch food whenever HP changes.

skills.name: Free Snacks
skills.description: Periodically grants a Snack Shield to allies within a wide range, while also recovering HP.

skills.name: Food Fight!
skills.description: Continuously hurls food at random targets. For enemies, deals damage or inflicts Stun. For allies, recovers HP or grants ATK Boost.

skills.name: Twin Charge
skills.description: Gains Charged - DMG Reduced and links 2 allies, granting them Charged - ATK Boost.

skills.name: Lightning Fast
skills.description: Periodically sends down lightning nearby, dealing small AoE damage.

skills.name: Orbs Away
skills.description: Periodically launches electric orbs.

skills.name: Full Charge
skills.description: Links all allies, granting them Charged: ATK Boost and Charged: DMG Reduction.

skills.name: Fire Orb
skills.description: Shoots a small ball of fire.

skills.name: Foxflame
